title: [ingest] Initial commit: orchestrator daemon, git integration foundation, judge/merge-back
summary: Baseline snapshot of the self-learning harness source — daemon, overlay/native-tasks libs, git worktree integration (init/branch/merge), judge skill, hooks, dashboard, tests. Secrets (certs/, token) and runtime state (overlay/, sessions/, worktrees/, workspace) are gitignored.
